svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Kalchar architecture
svg.desc: Kalchar architecture. 13 components in 2 groups. Connections: Visitor to Vercel edge; Maintainer to Vercel edge; Visitor to WhatsApp (wa.me link); Vercel edge to Public pages; Vercel edge to proxy.ts (/admin); Vercel edge to Cloudflare R2 (/media rewrite); Public pages to Lead action; Public pages to Neon Postgres (at build and on change); Lead action to Neon Postgres; proxy.ts to Admin; proxy.ts to Auth.js v5 (session); Auth.js v5 to Google OAuth (OAuth); Auth.js v5 to Neon Postgres (allowlist); Admin to Neon Postgres; Admin to Cloudflare R2 (sharp variants); Maintainer to Cloudflare R2 (presigned PUT); GitHub Actions to Vercel edge (health check); GitHub Actions to Cloudflare R2 (staging cleanup).

text.tspan: One Next.js app on Vercel: pages prebuilt from Neon, images from R2, sales on WhatsApp.
